$comment: The tools this artifact companion is permitted to call, and nothing else. This file is a DECLARATION, not an enforcement point: enforcement is the scope check in apps/api/isaac_api/mcp/server.py and the closed operation allowlist in apps/api/isaac_api/mcp/policy.py, which run whatever a client does with this file. The declaration exists so that a drift between what the companion asks for and what the server permits is a failing test rather than a discovery in production.

tools.title: Answer blocking questions
tools.purpose: Close an open blocking question with a user-confirmed answer.

tools.title: Check a run
tools.purpose: Run the non-mutating validation check over a run and report findings.

tools.title: Add a run to a record
tools.purpose: Add a new run to a record (draft content only).

tools.title: Read one record
tools.purpose: Read one record's current draft state and workflow status.

tools.title: Inspect a record's evidence
tools.purpose: Read the evidence supporting a record's field values.

tools.title: List records
tools.purpose: List the scientist's records so the companion can offer a choice.

tools.title: List blocking questions
tools.purpose: List the open blocking questions that stop a record exporting.

tools.title: List a record's runs
tools.purpose: List the runs belonging to a record.

tools.title: Write draft values
tools.purpose: Write draft values the scientist has explicitly confirmed.

never.$comment: Capabilities this companion must never acquire. Each is refused server-side by non-implementation; repeating them here makes a well-meaning future edit to the companion a test failure.
never.submit: No tool submits a record. docs/ai-integration-decision-packet.md 6.2.
never.export: No tool mints an official record or its evidence sidecar.
never.delete: No tool deletes or discards a record, run, or asset.
never.governance: No tool changes governance, roles, or visibility.
never.migration: No tool applies a database migration.
